07-11-1295 is November 7, 1295.  
Add 22 days:  
November has 30 days, so from Nov 7: 30 - 7 = 23 days left in November.  
22 days total: first 23 days use up all November days? Wait, 22 days from Nov 7:  
Nov 7 + 23 days = Nov 30 (that’s 23 days later). But we only add 22 days:  
Nov 7 + 22 days = Nov 29? Let’s check:  
Days in November after Nov 7: 30 - 7 = 23 days left.  
We add 22 days, which is less than 23, so still in November.  
Nov 7 + 22 = Nov 29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1295-11-29
